invariants.description: Every core state has one canonical owner and writer.
Only Brain generates a Decision Candidate; execution is separate.
Unvalidated provider/model output cannot become Reality or Fact.
Action requires a governed request and authorization gate.
Long-term Memory requires admission and cannot be written directly by Action or Provider.
Self Regulation and Evolution cannot rewrite Identity, Value, Goal, or Constitution directly.
L0 Constitution cannot be modified by ordinary Runtime or Core modules.
